query: SELECT ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome, ls.setorId, s.nome as setorNome, SUM(ls.valor) as total FROM lancamento_salario ls JOIN conta_custo cc ON ls.contaCustoId = cc.id LEFT JOIN setores s ON ls.setorId = s.id WHERE ls.periodoCustoId = 60001 AND ls.setorId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome, ls.setorId, s.nome ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
